subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Morocco-China technology cooperation framework
what_would_settle_it: A signed state-to-state instrument; the base holds six sources on this subject and every one is a vendor relationship, with no government-level framework on file

subject: geopol.usa
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Morocco-United States bilateral digital or artificial-intelligence agreement
what_would_settle_it: A signed bilateral instrument on digital or artificial-intelligence cooperation; the base now holds the 2023 protocol extending the two states' 2006 science and technology agreement, which is not one, and otherwise a commercial guide, ambassadorial attendance at two openings and an unresolved satellite licensing position

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Founding decree or statute for the Al-Jazari institutes
what_would_settle_it: The founding agreements or the constituting decree; the base now holds the ministry's own accounts of four regional or thematic signings from 2025-04-14 and of the founding institute launched 2026-01-12, and no statute, legal form, governance structure, budget, campus or intake for any of them

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial-intelligence roadmap "Morocco AI 2030"
what_would_settle_it: The roadmap text or a ministry announcement of the roadmap itself; the ministry's 2026-01-12 record names "AI Made in Morocco" as a national event and frames the founding institute as consolidating Maroc IA 2030, so the two names are an event and a framework rather than two roadmaps, and no text of either is held

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Official start-up investment statistics
what_would_settle_it: A publication by the digital development agency, the investment agency or the ministry giving funded-company counts and amounts; the agency's own 1,028-entry start-up database (2025-01-03) carries no funding amounts, and investment totals remain two third-party trackers whose 2025 Morocco figures disagree

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up legal status
what_would_settle_it: A bill, decree or published legal definition of start-up status; the base carries a 3,000-start-up target and several accelerator programmes, and no instrument conferring status

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Commune-level rollout of the procedures portal
what_would_settle_it: Interior ministry or local-government reporting on commune-level implementation; the subject carries no Morocco sources at all, and local government appears only as the addressee of national circulars

subject: geopol.eu
name: Accession to the modernised Council of Europe data-protection convention
what_would_settle_it: The ratification or accession instrument for the modernising protocol, or a statement that Morocco has not acceded to it; accession to Convention 108 itself is now established from the 2012 committee opinion and the regulator's recital of a 2019 ratification, and nothing on file addresses the modernised text

subject: gov.discourse
name: Ombudsman's 2025 annual report
what_would_settle_it: The report's own text; it was presented in Rabat on 2026-07-23 and is known only through two press accounts, and the wiki records that the institution's own site is unreachable

subject: gov.legislate
name: Promulgated organic law amending the electoral code
what_would_settle_it: The gazette publication of the enacted electoral organic law; the base holds the bill as tabled with its provisions, and no held source carries the adoption or constitutional-review dates, so every citation must say it rests on the draft

subject: gov.policy
name: Digital Morocco 2030 progress report
what_would_settle_it: An official progress or monitoring publication against the strategy's stated targets; the base carries the targets and no delivery figure against any of them at any date

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection authorisation for the facial-recognition patrols
what_would_settle_it: A data-protection commission decision, authorisation or opinion covering live facial recognition in the patrol vehicles; the base now holds the commission's 2019-2020 facial-recognition instruments and its 2025-03-21 decision to open hearings towards a video-surveillance deliberation, none of which reaches the patrols, and law 09-08 article 2(4) excludes processing in the interest of national defence and state security

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection commission annual report
what_would_settle_it: Any annual or activity report of the national data-protection commission; the base now holds four of its deliberations and two communiques directly, and still no enforcement statistics, registration counts or sanction record for any year

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: A named national digital-literacy or basic-skills programme document, or a household digital-skills survey; the base now holds public-university digital enrolment and a training count from the ministry's talent brochure, and nothing on citizen-level literacy

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital ministry appropriation in the 2026 finance law
what_would_settle_it: The 2026 finance law or the ministry's budget annexes for 2025 and 2026; the ministry's own budget-by-chapter series is now held to 2024 and stops there, so no appropriation is established for either year the report covers

subject: include.divides
name: National digital inclusion index or indicator framework
what_would_settle_it: A ministry or planning-commission publication defining inclusion indicators and targets; the base carries the published finding that inclusion objectives are not operationalised and a connectivity baseline from a private tracker, and no Moroccan inclusion index, vulnerability profiling or territorial targeting instrument

subject: infra.capacity
name: National cybersecurity workforce plan
what_would_settle_it: A government plan or published target for cybersecurity skills; the base holds one vendor study's figures of 6,000 certified professionals against demand above 12,000, and a general target of training 100,000 people by 2030, with no cybersecurity-specific plan, intake target or progress reporting
